tools.name: agent_lane
tools.summary: Open a fresh parent with open_parent; retain its scoped capability to control independent agent conversations. Never place the capability in task text or files.

tools.name: approximate_location_lookup
tools.summary: Resolve approximate location after explicit consent

tools.name: archive_create
tools.summary: Create a bounded deterministic ZIP or TAR without overwriting

tools.name: archive_extract
tools.summary: Extract a bounded archive transactionally without replacing a destination

tools.name: archive_list
tools.summary: Inspect a bounded archive without extracting it

tools.name: artifact_risk_inspect
tools.summary: Statically inspect a guarded artifact for risk

tools.name: build_fix
tools.summary: Repair a failing C/C++ build target with a bounded loop: compile the focus file, propose a patch confined to editable project sources (never build scripts or build-time-tool sources), verify with compile_one then a target build, keep the best candidate and revert regressions. Returns a job id for build_fix_result.

tools.name: build_fix_restore
tools.summary: Write a build_fix job's stored original files back (all, or the named ones) when each file still has the content the fix left; refuses a file changed since.

tools.name: build_fix_result
tools.summary: Wait (bounded) for a build_fix job you started and return its report: status, stop reason, attempts, per-file digests and diffs, and the final build; cancel=true stops your own fix and its child build instead.

tools.name: build_job
tools.summary: Configure, build, compile one file, or trace one file's includes, with a host-owned command rendered from closed templates for the project's build system; every value must name a member of build_model. Runs as a background job and returns typed, attributed diagnostics or a job id for build_job_result.

tools.name: build_job_result
tools.summary: Wait (bounded) for a build_job you started and return its report, or its status while it is still running; cancel=true stops your own job instead.

tools.name: build_model
tools.summary: Describe a C/C++ project's build without running anything: build system, generator, configs, platforms, targets (utility and build-time-tool flags), toolchains, compile units, PCH and presets, read from the CMake File API reply, compile_commands.json or .sln/.vcxproj. Labels only, no host paths.

tools.name: compute_artifact_fetch
tools.summary: Fetch one small digest-verified compute artifact through the authenticated transport

tools.name: compute_cancel
tools.summary: Cancel one previously placed compute job and prove cleanup

tools.name: compute_status
tools.summary: Read one previously placed compute job

tools.name: compute_submit
tools.summary: Place one bounded catalog job locally or on an explicitly authorized private node

tools.name: crash_digest
tools.summary: Symbolize and walk a crash capture with a host debugger (cdb, gdb, lldb, eu-stack, minidump-stackwalk or llvm-symbolizer on verified PE+PDB/ELF pairs) as a background job over the pure reader's result; returns the merged crash report or a run id to poll with debug_run_result. symbol_dirs must be local directories inside the allowed roots. symbol_server=true is refused from a tool call: the operator runs /crash <dump> --symbols-online at the console.

tools.name: crash_triage
tools.summary: Read a crash capture without running anything: a Windows/Breakpad/Crashpad minidump, an ELF core, a sanitizer (ASan/UBSan/TSan/MSVC-ASan) log, valgrind memcheck XML or a macOS .ips; returns a typed crash report (exception, crashing thread frames, modules with PDB/build ids, cause hints, signature). With a directory path, reads up to 64 captures in it (non-recursive) and returns buckets grouped by crash signature.

tools.name: data_inspect
tools.summary: Inspect a bounded data file

tools.name: data_query
tools.summary: Run a bounded read-only data query

tools.name: debug_run_result
tools.summary: Wait (bounded) for a crash_digest or profile_capture_digest run you started and return its result, or its status while it is still running.

tools.name: dependency_inventory
tools.summary: Inventory bounded project dependencies

tools.name: directory_create
tools.summary: Create a guarded directory and optional parents

tools.name: directory_digest
tools.summary: Digest a bounded directory manifest

tools.name: directory_tree
tools.summary: List a bounded guarded directory tree

tools.name: edit_file
tools.summary: Apply a bounded text edit

tools.name: fetch_artifact
tools.summary: Fetch and atomically verify a binary artifact

tools.name: file_batch_write
tools.summary: Transactionally create or overwrite bounded files

tools.name: file_copy
tools.summary: Copy one bounded binary-safe file

tools.name: file_delete
tools.summary: Delete a guarded path only after explicit confirmation

tools.name: file_digest
tools.summary: Digest a bounded file

tools.name: file_edit
tools.summary: Legacy alias for a bounded text edit

tools.name: file_find
tools.summary: Find files under allowed roots

tools.name: file_move
tools.summary: Move one bounded binary-safe file

tools.name: file_read
tools.summary: Read a UTF-8-ish text file inside allowed roots

tools.name: file_read_range
tools.summary: Read a bounded line range from a text file

tools.name: file_write
tools.summary: Create, overwrite, or append a text file inside allowed roots

tools.name: image_inspect
tools.summary: Inspect bounded image metadata and hash

tools.name: json_patch
tools.summary: Preview or atomically apply a bounded JSON patch

tools.name: log_inspect
tools.summary: Inspect a bounded log file

tools.name: make_directory
tools.summary: Create a directory under an allowed root

tools.name: output_digest
tools.summary: Summarize a test-run job's output or a guarded log file: final summary line, counts, FAILED/ERROR lines, first unique errors (file:line), grouped diagnostics and the tail. Give exactly one of job_id or path.

tools.name: process_list
tools.summary: List bounded process metadata after explicit opt-in

tools.name: process_memory_risk_inspect
tools.summary: Inspect bounded process memory risk indicators

tools.name: profile_capture_digest
tools.summary: Digest a binary profiler capture with a host tool (perf report, heaptrack_print, tracy-csvexport, xperf) as a background job; returns the profile digest or a run id to poll with debug_run_result.

tools.name: profile_digest
tools.summary: Digest a profiler capture in a pure format without running anything: callgrind, Chrome trace JSON, Tracy csvexport CSV, WPA/PIX/Superluminal CSV, heaptrack_print text or perf report text; returns hot functions (self/total), hot paths, frame-time percentiles and spikes against a frame budget. Binary captures (perf.data, .etl, .tracy, heaptrack .zst) give CAPTURE_NEEDS_HOST_TOOL: use profile_capture_digest.

tools.name: program_search
tools.summary: Search the executable path for programs

tools.name: project_detect
tools.summary: Detect project manifests and commands

tools.name: read_file
tools.summary: Read a bounded file

tools.name: run_program
tools.summary: Run an argv-based program

tools.name: run_script
tools.summary: Run a bounded script

tools.name: script_search
tools.summary: Find scripts under allowed roots

tools.name: secret_scan
tools.summary: Scan an authorized tree for redacted credential findings

tools.name: test_run
tools.summary: Run a project's test suite with a host-owned command for the detected runner (or the one named), optionally narrowed by a selector (pytest node id or k:<expr>, ctest name, cargo filter, ./go/pkg or run:TestName, dotnet filter, js path, jvm pattern), as a background job; returns a structured report (totals, failures with file:line) or a job id to poll with test_run_result.

tools.name: test_run_result
tools.summary: Wait (bounded) for a test_run job you started and return its structured report, or its status while it is still running.

tools.name: text_patch
tools.summary: Preview or transactionally apply a bounded unified diff

tools.name: text_search
tools.summary: Search bounded text files under allowed roots

tools.name: tool_inventory
tools.summary: List developer tools installed on this host (compilers, build systems, test runners, linters, debuggers, package managers, runtimes, containers, VCS, DB clients, media/doc tools, cloud CLIs, editors, shells) with versions; filter by category or name; refresh re-probes with fixed read-only version switches.

tools.name: verify_artifact
tools.summary: Verify a guarded artifact already on disk

tools.name: vision_analyze
tools.summary: Analyze one guarded local raster image

tools.name: weather_lookup
tools.summary: Get bounded weather with explicit consent

tools.name: web_fetch
tools.summary: Fetch bounded public web text with explicit consent

tools.name: web_search
tools.summary: Search public web with explicit consent

tools.name: workspace_compare
tools.summary: Compare two bounded workspaces

tools.name: workspace_run
tools.summary: Run a program as a bounded argv list

tools.name: write_file
tools.summary: Write a file under an allowed root
